welcome.title: Welcome to Nodevo
welcome.subtitle: A modern, blazing-fast forum platform. This wizard will guide you through installation in a couple of minutes.

search.title: Full-text search
search.desc: Powered by Postgres tsvector for fast queries.

responsive.title: Responsive & PWA
responsive.desc: Works on every device. Installable as an app.

environment.title: Environment check
environment.subtitle: Verifying your server meets the requirements for Nodevo to run.

database.title: Database connection
database.subtitle: Nodevo connects using the DATABASE_URL configured on your server. Verify it is reachable before continuing.

site.title: Site configuration
site.subtitle: Basic settings for your forum. You can change these later in the admin panel.
site.url_hint: The full URL where your forum will be accessible.
site.timezone_hint: Used for displaying dates and times across the platform.

admin.title: Create admin user
admin.subtitle: This account gets full administrative privileges. Choose a strong password.
admin.password_hint: Minimum 12 characters, include numbers and symbols.

finalize.title: Finalize installation
finalize.subtitle: Review your settings. Installation will run migrations, seed data, and create your admin account.

done.title: Installation complete!
done.subtitle: Your community is ready. You are already logged in as administrator.

toast.admin_invalid_email: Please enter a valid email address.
toast.admin_invalid_username: Username must be at least 3 characters.
toast.admin_invalid_password: Password must be at least 12 characters.
